description: Meta-schema validating the shape of loop/product/app-config.schema.json (a JSON Schema document in its own right, describing the product AppConfig persisted JSON contract). Deliberately shallow: it checks that the document looks like a well-formed schema (has $schema/schema_version/type/required/properties/additionalProperties of the right JSON types) without recursively re-validating every nested JSON-Schema keyword -- consistent with the rest of loop/schemas, none of which self-validate either.
